sourceCoverage.fullBodySelectionRule: Read only plausible acquisition sources needed to confirm or reject a structural gap or choose an origin.
sourceCoverage.note: All TOP 10 gaps have body evidence, but corpus-wide absence conclusions also depend on the complete metadata scan and remain bounded by unread bodies.

methodology.gapDefinition: A missing knowledge-map node or relation that breaks or weakens a learnable sequence.

priorityBands.P1: Missing prerequisite for multiple current PUBLIC/PENDING lessons, or a direct blocker on the public beginner path.
priorityBands.P2: Defensible bridge or sequence gap with clear downstream value but fewer current beneficiaries or higher research cost.
priorityBands.P3: Useful coverage expansion or tooling foundation not blocking several current lessons.

snapshot.legacyOnly: 77 of 83 SOURCE records are not represented by the five curriculum lifecycles; SOURCE readiness is not implied.

top10.proposedTopic: PHP od pierwszego skryptu: zmienne, wartości, typy, operatory i CLI
top10.whatExistsNow: PUBLIC control flow and arrays lessons. The focused control-flow analysis explicitly requires variables, scalar values, echo and CLI execution.
top10.whatIsMissing: A public entry node before both existing PHP lessons.
prerequisiteEvidence: lab/cartography/php-control-flow-single.json: variables, numbers/strings/bool, echo and PHP CLI are explicit prerequisites

sourceSupport.finding: Mentions dynamic typing and variable syntax only inside a broad PHP/Python comparison; insufficient as a bounded foundation.

top10.proposedTopic: JavaScript od pierwszego uruchomienia: wartości, zmienne, typy i operatory
top10.whatExistsNow: Three PENDING lessons start at conditions, array methods and DOM.
top10.whatIsMissing: One explicit entry node shared by all three candidates.
prerequisiteEvidence: Each of javascript-if-else-single.json, javascript-arrays-single.json and javascript-dom-single.json requires basic JavaScript syntax and running small examples.

sourceSupport.finding: A project catalogue, not a JavaScript foundation.
Begins with DOM, functions and classes rather than an entry model.

top10.proposedTopic: Funkcje i callbacki JavaScript przed tablicami i zdarzeniami
top10.whatExistsNow: PENDING arrays passes functions to map/filter/reduce; PENDING DOM registers a click callback; PENDING conditions defines a function.
top10.whatIsMissing: Parameters, return values, function forms and passing a function as behavior.
prerequisiteEvidence: The constructs are used in all three pending candidates but are not a dedicated PUBLIC/PENDING node.

sourceSupport.finding: Contains named functions, event callbacks and a Calculator class; useful bounded core after correcting scope and terminology.

top10.proposedTopic: Struktura HTML, atrybuty, klasy i selektory przed DOM
top10.whatExistsNow: PENDING DOM operates on an HTML document with id/class selectors; SOURCE 542 is a project overview and SOURCE 551 only names HTML/CSS as skills.
top10.whatIsMissing: A document-and-selector model before querySelector, classList and createElement.
prerequisiteEvidence: The DOM candidate uses HTML elements, ids, classes and selector strings without a prior current lesson.

sourceSupport.finding: Lists projects but does not teach HTML/CSS.
Names HTML/CSS as a competency but provides no instructional sequence.

top10.proposedTopic: Od wyniku do diagnozy: konsola, komunikaty błędów i minimalny przypadek
top10.whatExistsNow: All five code lifecycles ask learners to run examples and observe results. The dedicated-looking console SOURCE has an empty body; SOURCE 1575 only lists debugger tooling.
top10.whatIsMissing: A reusable feedback loop for unexpected output and runtime/syntax failures.
prerequisiteEvidence: Expected-output examples across current lessons imply the learner must compare observations and diagnose mismatches.

sourceSupport.finding: Zero-word body; the title does not provide coverage.
Mentions a debugger as one tool but does not teach a diagnosis workflow.

top10.proposedTopic: HTTP, JSON i asynchroniczny fetch między DOM a projektami API
top10.whatExistsNow: PENDING DOM covers local interaction. The SOURCE API/CRUD cluster contains overlapping intros and projects.
top10.whatIsMissing: A bounded bridge with request/response, status, JSON parsing, async flow and controlled error cases.
prerequisiteEvidence: The knowledge map jumps from local JavaScript/DOM to an API/CRUD cluster with no reviewed intermediate node.

sourceSupport.finding: Covers API, HTTP methods, JSON Server and Express but has an empty Async/Await section and overly broad scope.
Provides an introductory fetch example but mixes API types, external endpoints and server creation.

top10.proposedTopic: Testowanie małych funkcji: przypadki, granice i regresje
top10.whatExistsNow: Current lessons have deterministic examples and expected results. SOURCE 551 describes testing conceptually; SOURCE 281 supplies a small calculator domain.
top10.whatIsMissing: A learner-facing transition from running examples to choosing cases and automating assertions.
prerequisiteEvidence: Current materials repeatedly expose inputs and expected outputs but do not form a reusable testing node.

sourceSupport.finding: Defines unit testing at a high level without a bounded executable lesson.
Calculator operations offer testable examples but no testing method.

top10.proposedTopic: TypeScript przed Angularem: typy, interfejsy i funkcje

largestStructuralHole.finding: All five current code-focused PUBLIC/PENDING lifecycles begin after one or more absent foundations.

mostSurprisingGap.finding: A title suggests console coverage, but the full SOURCE body contains no instructional content.

blindDiscovery.reason: PUBLIC/PENDING prerequisites and teaching constructs expose missing entry and bridge nodes; bounded SOURCE reads distinguish real acquisition material from title-only apparent coverage.

confidenceLimitations: Seventy-one SOURCE bodies were not read in this run.
A complete metadata scan cannot prove a concept is absent from every unread body.
The knowledge map itself is an earlier selective interpretation and contains only eight inherited deep reads.
PENDING candidates are not public and may never be published.
Priority bands are qualitative editorial judgments, not calibrated scores.
Technical correctness and current-version claims require Researcher/Critic work.
